<!-- Title: type(scope): emoji subject, e.g. feat(pages): ✨ add the projects page.
     The title becomes the squash commit on main and drives the next version. -->

## Summary

<!-- What changes for a visitor or for the code, in two or three sentences. Link the issue. -->

## Type

- [ ] ✨ feat: new feature or content (minor)
- [ ] 🐛 fix: bug fix (patch)
- [ ] ⚡️ perf: performance (patch)
- [ ] ♻️ refactor: no behaviour change
- [ ] ✅ test: tests only
- [ ] 📝 docs: documentation only
- [ ] 🎨 style: formatting only
- [ ] 📦 build: build or dependencies
- [ ] 👷 ci: workflows
- [ ] 🔧 chore: tooling, config
- [ ] ⏪ revert: undo an earlier change
- [ ] 💥 breaking change

## How it was tested

- [ ] `pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build`
- [ ] Looked at the changed pages with `pnpm dev`

## Screenshots

<!-- UI changes: light and dark, at phone (360 px) and desktop widths. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tokens only: no raw colours, sizes, radii or shadows
- [ ] Works with a keyboard; images have alt text
- [ ] No invented facts about the owner; open questions are TODOs in drafts
- [ ] The code-reviewer agent passed the branch; UI changes also passed the design-reviewer agent
- [ ] Dependencies are exact versions, and new ones have the owner's approval
